option_relations.rationale: Candida tropicalis meningitis is a subtype of Candida tropicalis meningoencephalitis, as meningitis is inflammation of the meninges, while meningoencephalitis includes inflammation of both the meninges and the brain.
The option 'Candida tropicalis meningoencephalitis' is equivalent to the leaf '念珠菌性脑膜脑炎' (Candida meningoencephalitis), as both refer to the same condition.

Skull base osteomyelitis (fungal) can be a complication or a co-occurring infection with fungal meningoencephalitis, especially given the patient's otitis media and mastoiditis with local bone destruction.
The option 'Fungal meningoencephalitis (Candida tropicalis)' is equivalent to the leaf '念珠菌性脑膜脑炎' (Candida meningoencephalitis), as both refer to the same condition and specify the pathogen.
